```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"An accessible internet is not optional in the 21st century; it is a vital tool for receiving an education and for participating in the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All Americans need access to high-speed, affordable broadband service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take action to prevent states from blocking municipalities and rural co-ops from building publicly-owned broadband networks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase federal support for municipal broadband while requiring that funding recipients adhere to policies that support good jobs and include strong protections for workers' right to organize.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase public investment in rural, urban, and Tribal broadband infrastructure.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will offer low-income Americans subsidies for accessing high-speed internet.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will invest in digital literacy training programs so children and families and people with disabilities can fully participate in school, work, and life from their homes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restore the Federal Communications Commission's (FCC) clear authority to take strong enforcement action against broadband providers who violate net neutrality principles through blocking, throttling, paid prioritization, or other measures that create artificial scarcity and raise consumer prices for this vital service.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
